```{r}
con_inter_census <- dbConnect(odbc::odbc(),
                        Driver   = "SQL Server",
                        Server   = key_get("ccdph_sql_server"),
                        Database = "inter-census")

# import deaths data dictionary table from epi-vitals database
munis_scc <- dbReadTable(conn = con_inter_census,
            Id(schema = "ref", 
               table = "decennial-2020-total-by-muni"))

# import deaths data dictionary table from epi-vitals database
zctas_pop_cc <- dbReadTable(conn = con_inter_census,
            Id(schema = "ref", 
               table = "decennial-2020-total-by-zcta"))


con_inter_spatial <- dbConnect(odbc::odbc(),
                        Driver   = "SQL Server",
                        Server   = key_get("ccdph_sql_server"),
                        Database = "inter-spatial")

# import deaths data dictionary table from epi-vitals database
zctas_cc <- dbReadTable(conn = con_inter_spatial,
            Id(schema = "ref", 
               table = "zctas_cook_county_clipped")) 

# remove zctas with low population
zctas_cc_list <- zctas_cc %>% 
  select(geoid_zcta) %>% 
  left_join(zctas_pop_cc %>% mutate(geoid_zcta = as.character(geoid_zcta)), by="geoid_zcta") %>% 
  filter(str_sub(geoid_zcta, 1, 3) != "606",
         pop_in_cook >= 500,
         percent_pop >= 50) 

# set geographic and dataset parameters
state = "17" # Illinois
county = "031" # Cook County
akey = key_get("census_api_key")
years = 2010:2024
dataset = "acs5"
```

# by tract
```{r}

# Function to get ADI for a given year
get_county_adi <- function(y) {
  tryCatch({
    df <- get_adi(
      geography = "tract",
      dataset = dataset,
      year = y,
      state = state,
      county = county
    )
    df$year <- y
    return(df)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Year", y, "not available:", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Run loop for all years and bind results
adi_cook <- map_dfr(years, get_county_adi)

# 
scc_adi_tract <- adi_cook %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ADI:Educational_Attainment),
               names_to = "domain") %>% 
  mutate(layer = case_when(year < 2020 ~ "tract-2010",
                           year >= 2020 ~ "tract-2020"),
         metopio_key = case_when(str_detect(domain, pattern="ADI") ~ "ADICCDPH",
                                 str_detect(domain, pattern="Financial") ~ "ADIFIN",
                                 str_detect(domain, pattern="Economic") ~ "ADIECON",
                                 str_detect(domain, pattern="Educational") ~ "ADIEDU",
                                 .default = NA),
         metopio_column_name = paste0(metopio_key,"_",year)) %>%
  select(-c(NAME, year, domain, metopio_key),
         geoid = GEOID) 

scc_adi_tract_2010 <- scc_adi_tract %>% 
  filter(layer == "tract-2010") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = metopio_column_name, values_from = value)

scc_adi_tract_2020 <- scc_adi_tract %>% 
  filter(layer == "tract-2020") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = metopio_column_name, values_from = value)

write_csv(scc_adi_tract_2010, "data/scc_adi_tract_2010_atlas.csv")

write_csv(scc_adi_tract_2020, "data/scc_adi_tract_2020_atlas.csv")

```

# Zip code (zcta)
```{r}
# ---- Setup ----
# ZCTAs of interest (keep them as character to preserve leading zeros)
zctas <- c(zctas_cc_list$geoid_zcta)

# Years to compute (set a single year like 2017 if you prefer)
years <- 2010:2024

# ---- Helper: fetch ADI for ZCTAs in a given year ----

get_zcta_adi <- function(y) {
  tryCatch({
    df <- get_adi(
      geography = "zcta",
      dataset = dataset,
      zcta = zctas,
      state = NULL,
      county = NULL,
      year = y,
      raw_data_only = TRUE
    )
    df$year <- y
    return(df)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Year", y, "not available:", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# ---- Run for all years & bind ----
adi_zcta_raw_data_only <- map_dfr(years,get_zcta_adi)

test <- calculate_adi(adi_zcta_raw_data_only %>% filter(year == 2024) , keep_indicators = TRUE)

test <- test %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ADI_rescale = rescale(ADI, to=c(min(ADI*ADI/max(ADI)),100)))

test_adi <- test %>% 
  select(GEOID, ADI, ADI_rescale)
  
```
